name: Phenyl trimethicone
description: Phenyl trimethicone (CAS 73559-47-4 ), also known commercially as FT 8, is a phenyl-modified silicone fluid used across personal care and industrial applications. It provides a lightweight, non-greasy conditioning effect on skin and hair. The material delivers surface lubrication and wetting performance in technical processes. In hair care formulations, it deposits a refractive film on the hair shaft that enhances shine and reduces frizz without weighing the hair down. Skin care and color cosmetic formulators incorporate it to improve spreadability and deliver a silky after-feel in serums, foundations, and sunscreens. In textile finishing, it functions as a lubricating agent. This silicone reduces fiber-to-fiber friction during processing and improves the hand feel of finished fabrics. Leather treatment compounds use it to condition surfaces and improve water repellency without altering the material. Phenyl trimethicone is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid suitable for direct incorporation into emulsions and anhydrous systems. It is available in cosmetic-grade specifications meeting industry standards. The product is manufactured to meet high quality requirements for personal care use, with technical-grade variants supplied for textile and leather applications. Bulk supply is standard in drums and IBCs. Smaller packaging is available for formulation and sampling purposes to meet diverse client needs.
